name.value: Clearwater Country Inn Motel & RV Park

description.value: Clearwater Country Inn & RV Resort is a motel and campground property nestled minutes from the North Thompson River and the waterfalls of Wells Gray Provincial Park, offering cozy guest rooms alongside tent sites and 30-amp RV hookups. The inn provides plush rooms with free Wi-Fi and complimentary coffee, while the campground includes clean washrooms and hot showers. The property's 24/7 staff offers local insider tips, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Wells Gray region.
